message: `aria-relevant="additions text"` on the part sets the live region of `warning` otherwise than its role does
$reason: A warning part with its `status` and the `aria-relevant="additions text"` the role implies, written. It is refused outright, as a written `aria-live` is, not as a value other than the role's: Firefox 158 exposes no relevance at all for the `status` alone and `container-relevant` for the written one, and a reading that allowed the role's own value would have to say which spellings are it (`ADDITIONS TEXT` is exposed as written by both engines, measured on 2026-10-27).
